name: Kemono Gakuen
source:
Main character enters Veterinary high school only to find out that it's full of half-human half-monster students. Will he adapt in this curious place?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公进入一所兽医高中，才发现校内全是半人半兽的学生。他能适应这个奇妙的地方吗？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vndb-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
